# Relaxed wide-trouser design

**Retained artist target, October 4.** One garment-only sheet gives the wider-trouser direction a deliberately chosen profile and rear. It extends the [whole-character front concept](KNIT-CHARACTER-TARGET-2026-10-04.md) while preserving charcoal cloth and warm brown boots.

![Synthetic garment target: complete front, profile and rear of charcoal wide trousers over brown ankle boots](/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar/docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/trouser-design/trousers-v1.png)

The profile chooses a gently eased, convex seat flowing into a broad straight leg. The rear keeps a plain seat with a centre seam and continuous leg fall. A simple waistband, front fly and discreet front pockets provide a quiet tailored finish. Small hem folds give a controlled break over the boots, with readable toes, side heels and rear soles. These choices replace previously undefined side/rear styling with a concrete discussion target.

The waist and boots are complete in all three views, at comparable scale. The profile's boots have a slight stance offset. The sheet reads as front/profile/rear; it supplies no camera metadata, metric projection or proof that all views derive from one 3D surface. Medium rise is authored intent, not a measured fit result.

Future editable source must own waist, hip, seat, crotch, both legs, hems and boot interfaces, plus seams, material regions and body/foundation coverage. Physical dimensions, actual drape, pocket interiors, skinning, body ranges, morphs and moving fit remain open. This illustration provides no new wearable or representative starter qualification; the [full roadmap](../PRODUCT-ROADMAP.md) remains intact.

One fresh [COS page lookup](https://www.cos.com/en-eu-e/women/womenswear/trousers/wideleg/product/regular-wool-blend-wide-leg-trousers-black-1248656007) returned a country selector, so no new garment image or hidden geometry was observed. The sheet uses the existing artist direction and explicit new choices. [Reference limits](../evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/trouser-design/REFERENCES.md), [exact prompt](../evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/trouser-design/PROMPT.txt) and [root review](../evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/trouser-design/ROOT-IMAGE.md) retain that distinction. Built-in imagegen produced one original; it was copied byte-for-byte into the project without regeneration or image editing.

# Wide trousers — original artist blockout

Cora authored the complete unitless seat, shared crotch and broad straight legs. This is editable artwork for further garment work; cloth finish, physical folds, boot break, body fit and movement remain open.

![Original first front, profile and rear mesh views](/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar/docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/trouser-artist-source/triptych-first.jpg)

[Open the fixed three-view preview](http://127.0.0.1:5173/@fs/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar/docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/trouser-artist-source/index.html). [Literal artist source](ARTIST-DATA.json), [editable quad OBJ](export/trousers.obj), [mesh JSON](export/mesh.json), [authorship and interfaces](AUTHORSHIP.md), [original visual direction](../trouser-design/trousers-v1.png).

The first export has320 vertices/289 quads/578 triangles and one connected surface with exactly an open waist and two open hems. Independent root saved-data checks agree on the full quad graph, vertex links, boundary components and OBJ round trip. Those structural checks support the actual views; they do not establish global self-intersection, collision clearance, wearable fit or AAA quality.

The profile makes the larger rear seat explicit. Front and back show the continuous paired legs. The simplified crotch, planar band and clay shading are blockout choices. The original target's cloth texture, pockets, seams and boot folds are not present in this mesh.

[Exact source admission](SOURCE-RESULT.md), [actual export accounting](RUN.json), [root structural check](ROOT-DATA.json), [actual native record](NATIVE.json), [independent final review](RESULT.md) and [root handoff verification](ROOT-CLOSE.json).
